name: Joseph Gardient
mentions: MARRIED.—On the morning of the 16th., at Bismarck, by the Rev. Father ——, Miss Margaret, daughter of Joseph Gardient of New Richland, Minn. to J. L. Truscott, of Medora, D. T.  The above announcement is certainly a surprise to many here, but it would be hard to find a better mated coup…
